comments.text:
Feature: Kiva loan descriptions score a fund-this-loan decision

Scenario: Nationality clauses, including an American-borrower condition, shift funding
  Given real Kiva borrower stories with native-country and gender clauses (API/data terms for redistribution verified) and an American-borrower condition among the nationality set
  When I run bd score on the kiva-fund task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/kiva reports the signed shift vs the floor per nationality clause with a 95% interval

right_now_summary: The team is testing how nationality and gender details in Kiva stories affect funding decisions.
